command:
set -u
printf 'UTC='; date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ
printf 'IDENTITY='; id -un; hostname
printf 'RUNTIME_LINKS\n'; for p in /workspace/omega_runtime/current /workspace/omega_runtime/state /workspace/omega_runtime/releases /workspace/clay-global-research-entity; do ls -ld "$p" 2>&1 | head -1; done
printf 'PROCESSES\n'; ps -eo pid,etimes,args | grep -E '[o]mega.(supervisor|grid_runtime_v3|master_bridge_carrier|bridge_relay)|[o]mega_daemon.py' | head -25
printf 'RELEASES\n'; find /workspace/omega_runtime/releases -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -printf '%f\n' 2>/dev/null | tail -12
printf 'STATE_FILES\n'; find /workspace/omega_runtime/state -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name '*.db' -o -name 'STATE.json' -o -name 'LATEST.json' -o -name '*.sqlite' \) -printf '%p %s bytes\n' 2>/dev/null | head -30
printf 'CHECKOUT\n'; if test -d /workspace/omega_runtime/current/.git; then git -C /workspace/omega_runtime/current rev-parse HEAD; git -C /workspace/omega_runtime/current status --short | head -15; fi
printf 'MEMORY_DISK\n'; free -h | head -3; df -h /workspace | tail -1
